definitions.localAngular: All named rig-bone local quaternions; each normalized, adjacent sign aligned. Angle =4*atan2(norm(q1-q0),norm(q1+q0)), divided by actual sample dt.
definitions.worldAngular: Upper arm, forearm, wrist, and all finger-joint world quaternions, normalized and sign aligned.
definitions.tipAndWrist: Actual world-position displacement divided by sample dt. No target-point substitute.
definitions.finite: All named bones: position, quaternion, scale, all16 world-matrix entries; plus actual fingertip/wrist positions and quaternion validity.
definitions.extrema: Top8 sampled values per channel; exact sample endpoints, frame, note context, and paired deltas preserved.
definitions.outside: A movement interval is inside only when it overlaps a matching side/finger accepted window. Numerical difference counters use1e-7rad/s or1e-9m/s; raw maxima are retained regardless of that tolerance.
definitions.limitations: 120Hz sampled audit; higher-frequency between-sample extrema are not claimed. No skin/surface collision or native-film playback claim.

inputManifest.notes: Runtime copies are immutable snapshot compiled modules. Baseline source differs only in import paths, using the same frozen shared dependencies; original source retained for its exact hash.
